description: Use for a routine check of everything the traveler watches (for example a daily scheduled check, or "anything new on my watches?"): what dropped, what rose, new lows and the alerts SlickTrip sent in the last since_hours, with whether each moved price is lower than usual. One call covers every flight, bucket list, hotel and seat watch, from SlickTrip's records; it never runs a new search. For one watch in full, use watch_details.

since_hours.description: How far back to look, in hours: 24 for a daily check (the default), up to 168.
since_hours.title: Since Hours

name: check_my_watches

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

moved.description: Watches that moved or sent an alert: watch, kind, title, now_usd, was_usd, change_usd, lowest_seen, alerts_sent, price_check

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

steady.description: Watches with no move: watch, kind, title, now_usd

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

summary.description: Counts: watches, dropped, rose, new_low, alerts_sent, off_sale

title: Check every watch
